method: Viewed each supplied original page PNG; no local rendering or image modification. Original bodies and calibrated read-only pixel measurements independently rehashed. All added text and retained source controls checked for readability, clipping, overlap and actor semantics.
phoneMeasurementNote: Poppler font word boxes overlap the curved closing-parenthesis bounding box slightly (6.66925 square points petition, 3.795275 order). These are font boxes, not intersecting ink. Original pixels show two blank columns between the final area-code digit and closing parenthesis at all seven locations; full-page visual inspection confirms readable phone. Initial zero-word-box-intersection probe was appropriately refined to pixel separation, without changing candidate bytes.
